name: One sentence to campaign with your AI agent

parameters.content:
## One sentence to campaign with your AI agent

### How it works
Chat with your own AI model to build a whole outbound campaign from one sentence. The agent uses Argorant as its tools: it counts and previews matching people, saves them as a list, creates a campaign draft, writes the emails, adds the people (only valid emails join) and checks what still blocks a launch. It launches only after you confirm in the chat.

Costs: counts, previews, lists and drafts are free. Adding people costs 1 credit per new person. The agent asks before it adds people or launches.

### Setup
1. Install the community node **n8n-nodes-argorant** (tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.46.6): Settings > Community nodes > Install. Guide: https://github.com/argorant/n8n-nodes-argorant
2. Add an **Argorant API** credential with a key from Argorant (Settings, API keys).
3. Pick a chat model in **Chat model** and add its credential. Any chat model node works.
4. Connect sending mailboxes in Argorant before you launch.
5. Open the chat and describe who you want to reach.

### Customization
Edit the system message in **Campaign builder agent** to change the tone of the emails, the number of steps or your offer.

## Your AI model
Any chat model node works. It only plans and writes; Argorant does the data work.

## Argorant tools
Counting, previews, lists and drafts are free. Adding people costs credits. Launch needs a yes in the chat.

### Warning
Launch campaign sends real email. It only runs when the model sets the confirmation after your explicit yes.

options.systemMessage:
You build B2B outbound campaigns in Argorant for the user. Work step by step and keep answers short.
1. Turn the user's sentence into filters: job titles, industry in plain words, countries or regions, company size words. Call Count leads and report the number.
2. Call Preview leads for up to 10 people and summarize titles and companies. Never invent people.
3. When the user agrees, call Save as list with a clear name.
4. Call Create campaign draft, then write 2 or 3 short plain-text emails and save them with Write campaign emails. The first email has a subject and stays under 90 words. Use {{first_name|there}} and {{company|your team}}. No links and no placeholders such as [link].
5. Before Add list to campaign, tell the user how many people the list holds and that each new person costs 1 credit (only valid emails join). Call it only after the user says yes.
6. Call Check launch readiness and explain any blockers in plain words.
7. Ask: Launch now? Reply yes to start sending. Call Launch campaign only after the user's latest message is an explicit yes to launching. Never launch on your own.
Use only ids that the tools returned. If a tool fails, say what failed and what the user can do.
